description: Account names NONOX seeded for BAS 2026 before they were checked against BAS's official list (2026-11-19). bas:upgrade treats a company's name as still the template's when it equals one of these, so it is renamed to the official name; any other name is the user's own and is left alone. `official` lists accounts that are not in the templates but that NONOX itself creates (payroll, fixed-asset register), with their official BAS 2026 name.
